recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not reintroduce MessageHeader.enterer guidance; any cleanup of unreferenced legacy example files should be treated as separate maintenance rather than a seed reconciliation change.
issue_request: FHIR-32400 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core MessageHeader. It asked for more definition of MessageHeader.enterer and was resolved by removing enterer and adding guidance proposing removal of related sender/responsible/author metadata in favor of Task where persistent context is needed.
initial_application: Commit 7345c2bfebc9aab9e2a16611cb94df91710a9e9a removed MessageHeader.enterer from source/messageheader/structuredefinition-MessageHeader.xml and from the active source/messageheader/messageheader-example.xml example, and added Task-removal proposal comments to neighboring sender/author/responsible elements. The commit subject named FHIR-34096 but the patch matches the FHIR-32400 resolution.
additional_context: Later FHIR-41271 clarified that MessageHeader is needed to interpret a message bundle but should not provide persistent context after message resources are processed elsewhere. FHIR-32403 and FHIR-41269 later moved sender under source and removed author/responsible, and FHIR-45997 cleaned notes that still referred to deleted enterer/author/responsible elements. source/fhir.ini actively includes MessageHeader and carries legacy mappings that drop enterer/author/responsible and redirect sender to source.sender.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current StructureDefinition has no MessageHeader.enterer, the listed active MessageHeader example has no enterer, and the only remaining enterer occurrence is in source/messageheader/message-header-example.xml, which was not referenced by the active examples list or elsewhere in source.

related_jiras.note: The labelled application commit for this mapping issue also removed MessageHeader.enterer and added the Task proposal comments from FHIR-32400.

The R6 sender/author/responsible reconsideration moved sender under source and removed author/responsible; it was already represented on the combined branch.
